title: LawnMaster OcuMow 300 Series Robot Lawn Mower (VBRM601YCM MAX)

comparisons.notes: Exact model VBRM601YCM MAX, new, 24V 8.0Ah battery, 2000-3500 sq ft; sold and shipped by Skybest Appliance Center, ships free.

amazon_match_notes: Woot offer page lists Asin B0F1CGWZ6H, the LawnMaster OcuMow 300 Series VBRM601YCM MAX.
writeup: The LawnMaster OcuMow 300 Series (model VBRM601YCM MAX) is a new robot lawn mower that uses camera-based navigation instead of a buried perimeter wire. It runs on a 24V 8.0Ah battery for up to four hours and suits lawns of roughly 2,000 to 3,500 square feet. Woot has it new for $269.99, while Walmart lists the same model at $549.99, about 50% less here. Quantity is limited to 3 per customer.
